customers_deletion_request_pairs_ck.name: customers_deletion_request_pairs_ck
customers_deletion_request_pairs_ck.value:
(deletion_requested_at IS NULL AND purge_not_before_at IS NULL)
        OR (deletion_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND purge_not_before_at IS NOT NULL)

customers_retention_floor_ck.name: customers_retention_floor_ck
customers_retention_floor_ck.value:
redacted_at IS NULL
        OR (purge_not_before_at IS NOT NULL AND redacted_at >= purge_not_before_at)

customers_live_row_has_phone_ck.name: customers_live_row_has_phone_ck
customers_live_row_has_phone_ck.value: redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR phone IS NOT NULL

order_items_unit_price_foots_ck.name: order_items_unit_price_foots_ck
order_items_unit_price_foots_ck.value:
unit_price_paise = metal_value_paise + making_charge_paise + stone_value_paise
        + hallmarking_paise + other_charges_paise

orders_taxable_foots_ck.name: orders_taxable_foots_ck
orders_taxable_foots_ck.value:
taxable_paise = metal_value_paise + making_charges_paise + stone_value_paise
        + hallmarking_paise + other_charges_paise - discount_paise + shipping_paise

orders_no_cod_ck.name: orders_no_cod_ck
orders_no_cod_ck.value:
(payment_plan = 'full_prepaid' AND balance_due_paise = 0)
        OR (payment_plan = 'booking_advance' AND fulfilment_mode = 'store_pickup' AND balance_due_paise > 0)

orders_shipping_address_ck.name: orders_shipping_address_ck
orders_shipping_address_ck.value:
fulfilment_mode <> 'ship'
        OR (ship_name IS NOT NULL AND ship_line1 IS NOT NULL AND ship_city IS NOT NULL
            AND ship_state IS NOT NULL AND ship_pincode IS NOT NULL)

price_quotes_taxable_foots_ck.name: price_quotes_taxable_foots_ck
price_quotes_taxable_foots_ck.value:
taxable_paise = metal_value_paise + making_charges_paise + stone_value_paise
        + hallmarking_paise + other_charges_paise - discount_paise + shipping_paise

variants_pricing_inputs_ck.name: variants_pricing_inputs_ck
variants_pricing_inputs_ck.value:
(pricing_mode = 'dynamic_metal' AND net_metal_weight_mg IS NOT NULL AND fineness IS NOT NULL)
        OR (pricing_mode = 'fixed' AND fixed_price_paise IS NOT NULL)
        OR (pricing_mode = 'on_request')

variants_fineness_range_ck.name: variants_fineness_range_ck
variants_fineness_range_ck.value: fineness IS NULL OR (fineness > 0 AND fineness <= 1000)

variants_money_non_negative_ck.name: variants_money_non_negative_ck
variants_money_non_negative_ck.value:
stone_value_paise >= 0
      AND hallmarking_paise >= 0
      AND other_charges_paise >= 0
      AND (fixed_price_paise IS NULL OR fixed_price_paise >= 0)
